# PlayGonu

> PlayGonu is a collection of traditional Korean Gonu (고누) strategy board games, plus Gomoku. Every game is playable solo against a built-in AI (four difficulty levels) or online against another real person in real time — no install, no account, no download. Available in English, Korean, Spanish, Japanese and Simplified Chinese.

## Games

- [Cham-gonu](https://playgonu.com/index.html): The main game and PlayGonu's homepage. A 24-point board of three nested squares, 12 pieces per player — place pieces to form three-in-a-row "mills" and capture, then slide once the board fills. Same family as the Western game Nine Men's Morris.
- [Jul-gonu](https://playgonu.com/jul.html): The simplest Gonu variant — a 4x4-point line board, 4 pieces per player, sandwich (custodian) capture. A two-minute starter game.
- [Daseotjul-gonu](https://playgonu.com/daseotjul.html): Jul-gonu's exact rules on a bigger 5x5-point board with 5 pieces per side.
- [Palpal-gonu](https://playgonu.com/palpal.html): Jul-gonu's exact rules on the widest board in the family — 8x8 points, 8 pieces per side.
- [Bakwi-gonu](https://playgonu.com/bakwi.html): "Wheel gonu" — 4 pieces per side on a 4x4-point board; a piece standing on one of the board's four corner "wheels" can slide any distance in a straight line and capture the first enemy piece in its path.
- [Gomoku](https://playgonu.com/gomoku.html): The classic five-in-a-row game, not part of the Gonu family — Freestyle or Standard (Renju) rules, 15x15 board.

## Other pages

- [How to Play](https://playgonu.com/howto.html): Full written rules for every game on the site, in one place.
- [Cham-gonu strategy: the running mill](https://playgonu.com/cham-strategy.html): How Cham-gonu is usually won — a real game walked through with screenshots, the board's strongest points, and how to build or stop a running mill (a piece shuttling between two mills to capture every turn). Also in Korean, Spanish, Japanese and Chinese.
- [Online Battle](https://playgonu.com/online.html): Real-time multiplayer for Cham-gonu and Gomoku — create a private room and share the link, or join an open public room. No account needed, just a name.
- [Blog](https://playgonu.com/blog/index.html): Articles on Gonu's history and how it compares to Nine Men's Morris, Gomoku, and Renju.
- [Privacy Policy](https://playgonu.com/privacy.html)
- [Korean version (한국어)](https://playgonu.com/ko/index.html): The game pages, how-to and online battle in Korean, at the /ko/ path.
- [Spanish version (Español)](https://playgonu.com/es/index.html): The same pages in Spanish, at /es/.
- [Japanese version (日本語)](https://playgonu.com/ja/index.html): The same pages in Japanese, at /ja/ (Gomoku appears as 五目並べ).
- [Simplified Chinese version (简体中文)](https://playgonu.com/zh/index.html): The same pages in Simplified Chinese, at /zh/ (Gomoku appears as 五子棋).
